titulo: Maximum Product Pair With Target Sum
enunciado:
You are given an integer array nums and an integer target.

A pair of distinct indices (i, j) is valid if:


nums[i] + nums[j] == target

nums[i] > nums[j]

Return a valid pair [i, j] whose product nums[i] * nums[j] is maximum among all valid pairs. If no valid pair exists, return [-1, -1].

If multiple valid pairs achieve the maximum product, you may return any of them.

 

Example 1:

Input: nums = [1,2,3,4], target = 5

Output: [2,1]

Explanation:

ejemplos_few_shot.descripcion: Buscar pares de índices que suman un objetivo
ejemplos_few_shot.explicacion: Se exploran pares de índices distintos y se comprueba la suma.
ejemplos_few_shot.codigo_ilustrativo:
def pares(nums, target):
    return [(i,j) for i in range(len(nums)) for j in range(len(nums)) if i != j and nums[i]+nums[j] == target]
